scope: 36 predeclared geometric conditions, 30 unique point arrays, on two fixed transforms/resolutions; new to the frozen v3/v4 reader design but not independent physical objects or real-photo efficacy evidence

interpretation_limits.positive: Known construction axes are conditional geometric targets. Half surfaces, elliptic members and junctions do not prove physical target identity or graph topology.
interpretation_limits.negative: The supplied complete plane/ribbon/sheet/cloud construction contains no declared member axis. This is a declared geometric-family abstention test, not proof that similar partial views can never be real bars or objects.
interpretation_limits.unidentifiable: Exact same input arrays have contradictory semantic interpretations; not included in pass/fail denominators. Report outputs and conditional geometry only. RGB, identity or acquisition context is required to resolve the story.
interpretation_limits.gap: Use existing full and guarded gap proximity metrics unchanged; do not call centerline R/P success zero gap contamination.
interpretation_limits.scope: All new conditions are synthetic controls. Their count is not an independent-object count. No retuning after frozen inference.

freeze_note: Generator protocol and anonymous input arrays frozen before any v3/v4 replay. Old reader algorithms, defaults, scoring tolerances and positive/negative qualification remain unchanged. Preserve all outcomes and original legacy source bytes; LF mappings are identity metadata only.
